name: Citation & Grounding Accuracy
description: Adversarial grounding set. Every case supplies context; roughly half of the questions cannot be answered from it. A good model says so instead of filling the gap.

default_config.system_prompt: Answer only from the context. If the context does not contain the answer, reply exactly: 'The provided context does not contain this information.' Never use outside knowledge.

metric_notes.faithfulness: The headline metric: unanswerable cases are where hallucination shows up.
metric_notes.correctness: For unanswerable cases the correct answer is an explicit refusal.
metric_notes.answer_relevance: Detects hedging that never commits to an answer or a refusal.
